searchText: Hey guys i've been managing my own fats node for a few weeks and I've been having this error since shapella upgrade and can't figure out how to fix it Served engine_newPayloadV2 conn=192.168.176.2:36272 reqid=1 duration=4.217548ms err="Invalid parameters" errdata="{Error:nil withdrawals post-shanghai}" It's certainly a noob mistake I made so any help is more than welcome You need to update your geth node to `v1.11.5` Hahahaha I'm so stupid I'm using docker and my image is set as :stable I thought a simple docker compose pull and restart would do the trick but apparently not Yeah, its probably cached for that tag, so it doesn't pull in the new sha for the current `stable` tag. You can try with the `v1.11.5` tag I'll do that rn and keep you posted 🙂 thank's a lot still not working :/ Here is a little more data about what's happening if anybody has an idea pls save my day I'm slowly turning mad here Hi,Does anyone know that now the protocol returns the 32 ETH to validator is through withdrawal operation instead of a transaction when validator exit. Is that means the balance of deposit contract will also continue to increase as time goes by? > 32 ETH to validator is through withdrawal operation instead of a transaction when validator exit Just a balance increase. _Not_ a transaction. > that means the balance of deposit contract will also continue to increase as time goes by Yes

excerpts.author: steven_lll
excerpts.content: Hi,Does anyone know that now the protocol returns the 32 ETH to validator is through  withdrawal operation instead of  a transaction when validator exit. Is that means  the balance of deposit contract will also continue to increase as time goes by?

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content:
> 32 ETH to validator is through  withdrawal operation instead of  a transaction when validator exit
Just a balance increase. _Not_ a transaction.

> that means  the balance of deposit contract will also continue to increase as time goes by
Yes
